bug_info.bug_desc: When U-mode is not implemented (CVA6Cfg.RVU is false), the mstatus.TW (Timeout Wait) field is not normalized to zero during MSTATUS writes. As a result, TW can retain a written value even though the RISC-V privileged specification requires this field to be read-only zero when U-mode is not supported. The existing !CVA6Cfg.RVU branch clears mstatus_d.mprv but does not clear mstatus_d.tw.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the MSTATUS write-normalization logic, force mstatus_d.tw to riscv::Off when CVA6Cfg.RVU is false, alongside the existing mprv normalization. This ensures that TW reads back as zero and cannot retain unsupported state when U-mode is not implemented.
